ChromeOS 151 Rolls Out With Bookmark Bar Auto-Hide, Gemini Safe Browsing, and 18 Security Fixes

Google is rolling out ChromeOS 151 (version 16733.48.0, browser version 151.0.7922.141) to Chromebooks and ChromeOS Flex devices…
This update adds a bookmark bar auto-hide option, real-time Safe Browsing for Gemini sessions, ends support for legacy Chrome Apps…
This is one of the most security-focused ChromeOS updates in recent releases.
ChromeOS 151 adds new controls for bookmark bar visibility under Settings and then Appearance.
THE TAKEAWAY — If the bar is hidden because of low usage, Chrome shows a small notification so you can bring it back with one click.
